name: B10-0261/2026 (PfE) – Repression and execution of protesters, dissidents, political prisoners and religious minorities in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the repression and execution of protesters, dissidents, political prisoners and religious minorities in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Iran to stop executing protesters and political prisoners and to release everyone held for their beliefs or for speaking out. It condemns the repression of women, journalists and religious and ethnic minorities, and the internet shutdowns used to hide it. It asks the European Union to impose targeted sanctions on Iranian officials responsible, including judges, prison directors and security commanders, and urges EU member states to counter Iranian pressure and spying inside Europe. The text is a statement of position and demands; it does not itself change any law.

- Nothing changes yet: this is a non-binding call for action, not a law.
- It targets Iran's leaders and affects protesters, prisoners and minorities in Iran.
- Next, EU governments and officials decide whether to impose the sanctions.
